title: 上海高考高分翻译背诵-131-25二模

items.zh: 不少中国留学生选择学成后回国追逐梦想,报效祖国。
items.en: Quite a few Chinese international students opt to go back to pursue their dreams and serve their country after graduation.

items.zh: 丰收的秋日里,古镇上家家户户晒起一串串黄澄澄的玉米。
items.en: In the autumn harvest, every household in the ancient town exposes strings of golden corn to the sun.

items.zh: 听说那幅水墨画将被送去国外展览,市民在艺术馆的展厅前大排长龙,想在展品出国之前来欣赏一下。
items.en: It is said that the ink wash painting will be sent abroad for exhibition, so citizens have formed long queues in front of the gallery, hoping to admire the artwork before it leaves.

items.zh: 随着越来越多的人向往自然，崇尚简单和谐的生活方式，该县户外经济蓬勃发展,其收入有望在明年年底达到全县总收入的百分之十二。
items.en: As a growing number of people are drawn to nature and embrace a simple, harmonious lifestyle, the county’s outdoor economy is booming, with income expected to account for 12% of its total revenue by the end of next year.
